sourceSentences: [0] I would put Zeri in easy as well. She kind of both of you guys just scale really well so she can't really punish you in the lane.
[0] but you just have to be a bit careful as I said about trading alts because you know I think her alt is a much shorter CD than Xayah's alt if I'm not mistaken
[0] But overall in terms of the lane phase it's pretty straightforward to play against uh Zeri. You should be able to farm.
[0] The thing is Zeri also enjoys Xayah. Like Zeri enjoys playing against short range champions.
[0] if Zeri has really good movement and dodges your feathers or your E with her E or her you know, her old movement speed, then it can be hard for you to play
[1] She's an aggressive laner that adores to trade and all in post-six when she has her ultimate and main damaging ability.
[1] Her E allows her to jump walls and as long as there is a wall in front of her, she will be able to ride onto it all the way until it ends.
[1] This makes her very strong in a fights and skirmishes, but also very slippery to catch and lock down if you were to ask for ganks.
[1] she loves extended trades even more post-six with her ultimate. Poke from afar and always make short trades. Only all in her when she's low enough so that you can win.
[1] You can also trade until she uses ability since it has a high CD. Then try to force fights after.
[2] With that being said, most match-ups for Zeri are not very favorable as Zeri struggles in lane.
[2] she wins most match-ups once she gets level six just because of how much her R offers her.
[2] Much more burst damage, increased DPS from attack speed, chain lightning on secondary targets, and move speed. Gives Zeri a lot of leverage in fights.
